name: Lancashire
tagline: Aerospace, nuclear energy, cyber and seaside tourism, all packed into one county.
erb_name: North and Western Lancashire Chamber of Commerce
summary: Lancashire is home to 1.57 million people and over 728,000 jobs, with world-class strengths in aerospace and defence (BAE Systems, the National Cyber Force), nuclear energy, advanced manufacturing and Blackpool's visitor economy. Its LSIP is focused on fixing a growing 'experience gap' in recruiting skilled staff, tackling persistent social care shortages, and helping every sector keep up with fast-moving digital and AI skills needs.
